set.body: Deliver a real pinned HarfBuzz/FreeType component: pointer-only C shim, owned static font data and copied glyph positions/clusters, ink/advance metrics, grayscale raster masks, exact drawing/run resource retention, real Latin/Greek/Arabic fixtures and lifecycle/thread tests. Fetch through native/fetch-macos.sh --text after disk check. Add native extern inventory, font licenses/hashes, macOS CI and evidence. This is a run component only; parent paragraph/fallback/caret and P0.3b GPU atlas/golden qualification remain open.
set.title: G-0/P0.3b.1: Static-font shaping and owned coverage masks
